text:
maria: Quick tracker sync — target release Tuesday 2026-04-20. We need: SDK packaging, docs quickstart, sample app CI fix, changelog cutoff. Who's owning what?

alex: I'll take SDK packaging and npm/pypi uploads. Plan: branch + bump versions today, publish Monday AM. Will need a final sign-off on the changelog snippet.

nina: Docs + quickstart here. I'll finish the step-by-step tutorial and a minimal prompt-set by Mon 23:59 UTC. Can someone confirm sample app image name? I need it for docs links.

sam: Sample apps: failing integration on mac-builder (encrypted key access). Repro steps in thread: `./scripts/run_ci.sh --target=mac` fails on key fetch. I'll try a workaround today. ETA Wed if no blocker.

ryan: Heads up — infra change: runtime flag `--kv-cache=adaptive` merges Wed AM. That can change perf profile and might require sample app env var updates. Ping me if you want a compat shim.

alex: @ryan thanks — can you post a short note with the exact env var name? I can update packaging to inject it.

ryan: Sure — it's `RW_RUNTIME_KV_CACHE=adaptive`. Also recommended fallback `RW_RUNTIME_KV_CACHE=off`.

nina: got it. I'll update quickstart to show both and add a note about perf differences.

devrel-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff set to Tue 12:00 UTC. After cutoff, only critical fixes allowed. :bell:

maria: changelog deadline acknowledged. Please add one-line entries to `docs/changelog/2026-04-20.md` and include PR link.

alex: I'll open a PR with packaging + changelog snippet. Will @mention reviewers + eng-ship.

sam: If sample app CI stays red, can we feature-flag the mac example in docs? I can add a note linking to linux/mac matrix.

nina: That works — will include a short note and link to the CI issue.

ci-bot: Build #4781 failed: sample-app-mac (see https://ci.internal/builds/4781) — test logs attached.

sam: Investigating logs now; looks like HSM access scope is missing for mac runners.

maria: Priority order: 1) packaging publish, 2) changelog, 3) docs quickstart, 4) sample app CI fix. If any item slips, call it out here.

alex: Packaging on track. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/devex/pull/2345 — requesting reviews from @nina @sam

nina: Reviewing now.

sam: FYI I'm juggling an oncall page but will review tonight. If I can't finish, I'll leave a TODO in the PR.

maria: Good. One more ask — add a short migration note for Dedicated users re: KV cache flag. @ryan can you draft 2–3 lines?

ryan: On it. I'll drop a blurb in the PR under `docs/migration.md`.

maria: OK. Final: if you're blocked by infra, escalate to eng-infra and cc me. Otherwise we should be green by Monday for a Tuesday release. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

nina: :ok_hand:

sam: will post status by EOD.

maria: Thanks all — I'll do a follow-up summary tomorrow morning with an updated checklist.
